newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weak as another Russian trades low.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weak as another Russian trades low.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were weaker on Tuesday as crude oil futures sagged, traders said.
An ARA player bought a small prompt Dow quality Russian cargo at a p+c price which was well below published quotes.
Another prompt Russian cargo was heard offered by a European trader but the offer level was not known.
Another ARA player bought an Immingham cargo on Monday from its refinery partner at a quotes-related price.
An end user was heard with a full-range Bombay cargo available for $200 cif NWE, but buyers were some $6 a tonne below. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
